question: In February 2022, which Mabaratna Company of the Government of India was awarded India's most trusted Public Sector Company award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coal India Limited**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Coal India Limited (CIL) was awarded India's most trusted Public Sector Company award in February 2022 at the “Energy Meet and Excellence Award” function organized by ASSOCHAM in Kolkata. 
 
• CIL is a Maharatna public sector undertaking and the world's largest coal producer.
 
• It was founded in 1975 after the nationalization of the coal industry in 1973.
 
 
• CIL is headquartered in Kolkata and is under the administrative control of the Ministry of Coal, Government of India
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL), Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL), and GAIL India are all companies in India with notable activities in their respective sectors: 
 
• Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited
 
• HPCL is a company that has developed innovative technologies, including HP-AEME Technology for green hydrogen production, HP-WMA (Warm Mix Additive), and HP NanoKoat for corrosion resistance. 
 
• Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited
 
• BHEL is a large engineering and manufacturing company that offers products and services in areas such as power generation, transmission, transportation, defense, aerospace, and oil and gas. BHEL was the first Maharatna Company in India, established in 1964. 
 
• GAIL India
 
• GAIL India is a leading natural gas company in India that is involved in trading, transmission, LPG production, LNG re-gasification, petrochemicals, and city gas. GAIL was established in 1984 and has its headquarters in New Delhi. GAIL also has a subsidiary company, GAIL Global (Singapore) Pte Ltd., that manages investments abroad.
